scores.question: Which agreements contain a non-compete clause?
scores.answer:
The following agreements contain restrictions on competing business, endorsements, or sponsorships:

- **AMERICANPHYSICIANSCAPITALINC agency agreement** — §A.5 prohibits the agency from selling competing professional liability products in Nevada without MICOA’s written consent, with an exception for risks MICOA declines. [AMERICANPHYSICIANSCAPITALINC_03_31_2003-EX-10.26-AGENCY AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1]
- **ANIXABIOSCIENCESINC collaboration agreement** — §2.6 prohibits OntoChem and its affiliates from independently or jointly researching, developing, manufacturing, or commercializing products directed to the agreement’s targets during its term. [ANIXABIOSCIENCESINC_06_09_2020-EX-10.1-COLLABORATION AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **BizzingoInc endorsement agreement** — §9(a) prevents Theismann from licensing his endorsement property for identical or substantially similar networks during the term and for one year afterward. [BizzingoInc_20120322_8-K_EX-10.17_7504499_EX-10.17_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 5]
- **LegacyEducationAllianceInc development agreement** — §3.3 prohibits T&B and its affiliates from offering or selling the same or similar products or services within the Exclusive Field of Use during the term. [LegacyEducationAllianceInc_20200330_10-K_EX-10.18_12090678_EX-10.18_Development Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **PerformanceSportsBrandsInc endorsement agreement** — §3 prohibits North from entering agreements to endorse or promote similar products during the term within the contract territory. [PerformanceSportsBrandsInc_20110909_S-1_EX-10.10_7220214_EX-10.10_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **PROLONGINTERNATIONALCORP sponsorship agreement** — §7 prohibits Sabco from representing or accepting sponsorship from companies competitive with Prolong products during the term. [PROLONGINTERNATIONALCORP_03_23_1998-EX-10.16-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]

Related exclusivity restrictions also appear in:

- **2ThemartComInc co-branding agreement** — §2.4 prohibits banner advertisements for 2TheMart’s competitors on the co-branded site. [2ThemartComInc_19990826_10-12G_EX-10.10_6700288_EX-10.10_Co-Branding Agreement_ Agency Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **N2KINC sponsorship agreement** — §1(a) restricts Excite from displaying advertising for other retail music stores or promoting other suppliers’ music products, subject to stated exceptions. [N2KINC_10_16_1997-EX-10.16-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1]
- **AMBASSADOREYEWEARGROUPINC endorsement agreement** — §4 prohibits other licenses of KI’s name and likeness for specified products within the licensed territory during the term. [AMBASSADOREYEWEARGROUPINC_11_17_1997-EX-10.28-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]

scores.question: Which agreements contain an exclusivity commitment?
scores.answer:
The agreements containing an exclusivity commitment are:

- [AMBASSADOREYEWEARGROUPINC_11_17_1997-EX-10.28-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2] — exclusive license for specified products; the licensor agrees not to grant competing licenses for those products during the term.
- [AMERICANPHYSICIANSCAPITALINC_03_31_2003-EX-10.26-AGENCY AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1] — exclusive agency appointment in Nevada, with the agency barred from selling competing professional-liability products without consent.
- [ANIXABIOSCIENCESINC_06_09_2020-EX-10.1-COLLABORATION AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3] — target exclusivity prevents OntoChem and its affiliates from researching, developing, manufacturing, or commercializing compounds directed to specified targets outside the agreement.
- [KitovPharmaLtd_20190326_20-F_EX-4.15_11584449_EX-4.15_Manufacturing Agreement.pdf p. 4] — Dexcel must manufacture and supply the product exclusively for Kitov.
- [LegacyEducationAllianceInc_20200330_10-K_EX-10.18_12090678_EX-10.18_Development Agreement.pdf p. 3] — LEA receives the sole and exclusive worldwide license to the licensed intellectual property.
- [N2KINC_10_16_1997-EX-10.16-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2] — Excite must negotiate exclusively with the sponsor for a specified renewal period.
- [PerformanceSportsBrandsInc_20110909-S-1_EX-10.10_7220214_EX-10.10_Endorsement Agreement.pdf p. 4] — the endorser may not endorse or promote similar products for another company during the term and in the contract territory.
- [PROLONGINTERNATIONALCORP_03_23_1998-EX-10.16-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2] — Sabco may not represent or accept a sponsorship from a company reasonably deemed competitive with Prolong.

scores.question: Which agreements contain a most-favored-nation clause?
scores.answer:
**ENTRUSTINC_07_24_1998-EX-10.5-STRATEGIC ALLIANCE AGREEMENT.PDF** contains two “Most Favoured Treatment” provisions:

- **Section 4.02:** Expresses ETI’s intention that Nortel’s reseller agreement terms be no less favourable than those offered to any Entrust reseller when the agreement is executed. [ENTRUSTINC_07_24_1998-EX-10.5-STRATEGIC ALLIANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]

scores.question: Which agreements are perpetual, with no fixed end date?
scores.answer:
The documents identify these agreements as having perpetual rights or terms with no fixed end date:

- **Anixa Biosciences Collaboration Agreement**: grants Anixa a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid-up license under OntoChem’s patents. [ANIXABIOSCIENCESINC_06_09_2020-EX-10.1-COLLABORATION AGREEMENT.PDF p. 8]
- **Entrust Strategic Alliance Agreement**: grants Nortel a perpetual, fully paid-up, worldwide license to use unlimited copies of Entrust products. [ENTRUSTINC_07_24_1998-EX-10.5-STRATEGIC ALLIANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **Garrett Motion Intellectual Property Agreement**: grants SpinCo a perpetual, fully paid-up, worldwide license to specified Honeywell shared intellectual property. [GarrettMotionInc_20181001_8-K_EX-2.4_11364532_EX-2.4_Intellectual Property Agreement.pdf p. 9]
- **Sparkling Spring Water Software License and Maintenance Agreement**: remains in effect perpetually while fees are paid and it is not otherwise terminated. [SPARKLINGSPRINGWATERHOLDINGSLTD_07_03_2002-EX-10.13-SOFTWARE LICENSE AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]

The first three describe perpetual licenses rather than necessarily making the entire agreement perpetual. The Sparkling agreement expressly states that the agreement itself continues perpetually, subject to payment and termination provisions. [SPARKLINGSPRINGWATERHOLDINGSLTD_07_03_2002-EX-10.13-SOFTWARE LICENSE AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
